steps.title: Open the home page
steps.narration: Let's start on Trendora's home page, where the Market Phase & Severity card gives an at-a-glance read on today's market regime.
steps.point_out: The Market Phase & Severity card renders a live severity score and regime label the moment the page loads — never a blank or 'unavailable' state.

steps.title: Open the Data Manager
steps.narration: Next, the Data Manager page — this is where the dataset's coverage is tracked and where new historical days get backfilled into the scanner.
steps.point_out: The Dataset coverage panel shows real numbers for price history, universe size, trading days, and any backfill gaps — all computed and cached ahead of time, not recomputed on the spot.

steps.title: Enter a backfill start date
steps.narration: Typing a start date into the backfill form is the first step in growing the dataset for a specific day.

steps.title: Enter a backfill end date
steps.narration: The end date completes the range — here it's the very same single day.

steps.title: Start the backfill job
steps.narration: Clicking Start submits the job. Because this particular day was already covered by an earlier run, Trendora immediately and honestly reports there was no new work to do — a distinct, clearly-labeled outcome rather than a misleading 'success'.
steps.point_out: The job status badge reads 'no new snapshots' in a neutral grey — visually different from the green badge used for a truly new backfill.

steps.title: Browse the Scanner Runs history
steps.narration: Every day the scanner has run lives here as an immutable, dated snapshot — including the day we just looked up.
steps.point_out: The row for May 15, 2026 shows its regime, actionable count, and stock count immediately — no loading skeleton, no refresh needed.

steps.title: Open a single day's scan
steps.narration: Clicking into a date opens the exact, unchanging view the scanner produced that day.
steps.point_out: The Scanner Run page reproduces the same regime and counts seen in the table, with a full leaderboard of stocks below it — pulled straight from the stored snapshot, not recomputed live.

steps.title: Return to the run list
steps.narration: The 'All runs' link takes you straight back to the full history.

steps.title: Back to the Data Manager
steps.narration: Back on the Data Manager page to see the form's validation and how it handles a much larger date range.

steps.title: Try an invalid date
steps.narration: Typing an impossible calendar date shows how the form catches mistakes before they ever reach the server.

steps.title: See the inline validation
steps.narration: Moving focus away from the field reveals a clear, specific error — and the Start button stays disabled until the date is fixed.
steps.point_out: A red inline message reads 'Enter a valid date as yyyy-MM-dd', and no job is ever submitted for an invalid date.

expect.text: Enter a valid date as yyyy-MM-dd

steps.title: Enter a much wider date range
steps.narration: Fixing the start date to a real, far earlier day sets up a much bigger backfill — over a year of history in one request.

steps.title: Enter the range's end date
steps.narration: The end date extends the span past 370 days — well beyond what older, capped systems would allow.

steps.title: Start the large backfill
steps.narration: Trendora accepts the whole range at once — no 'range too large' rejection — and processes it in visible chunks, so you can watch real progress on even a very large job.
steps.point_out: The Job progress panel shows a chunk counter and an advancing progress bar, proving the big request was accepted and is actively executing.
